o.text: Ultimately from Ancient Greek κόλπος (kólpos, “gulf, bay, creek”). Cognate with English gulf.
From Proto-Turkic *tēk. Cognate with Turkish tek, Turkmen täk, Tatar and Bashkir тик (tek), Kazakh тек (tek), Tuvan тик (tik, “zero”) etc.

Etymology tree
Arabic اِحْتَاطَ (iḥtāṭa)
Arabic اِحْتِيَاط (iḥtiyāṭ)bor.
Azerbaijani ehtiyat
Borrowed from Arabic اِحْتِيَاط (iḥtiyāṭ), from اِحْتَاطَ (iḥtāṭa).

From Classical Persian بیش بَدْتَر (bēš badtar). Often thought of as the phrase beş (“five”) + betər, i.e. to the effect of "five times worse than". Compare Turkish beş beter, Turkmen bäşbeter, Uzbek beshbattar.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آدالمق (aralamaq). By surface analysis, ara + -la.
